chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿUtbah al-Hāshimī, who said:
I asked Abā al-Ḥasan عليه السلام about a woman: is it permissible for her husband to uncover himself and perform ghusl in the presence of her servant?
He عليه السلام said: “There is no harm in whatever of that she has made permissible for him, so long as he does not go beyond it.”

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or legal objection
key_terms.مَا لَمْ يَتَعَدَّهُ: so long as he does not go beyond that limit

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a husband to uncover himself and perform ghusl in the presence of his wife's servant?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the husband's conduct regarding uncovering himself and performing ghusl in relation to the wife's servant. The Imam عليه السلام states that there is no problem in what the woman permits of that, provided the husband does not exceed the limit of what has been allowed.
